{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Desserts]] | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Germany|German Cuisine]]

This version of '''strudel''' uses filo pastry to create the thin sheets. Serve warm with ice cream.

==Ingredients==
*4 fresh [[Cookbook:Apple|apples]], preferably red 
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] ground [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:White Sugar|white sugar]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] melted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*[[Cookbook:Phyllo Dough|Filo pastry]] sheets

==Procedure==
#Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 200°C.
#Peel, core, and [[Cookbook:Cube|cube]] apples. 
#Combine apples, cinnamon, and sugar. Mix well. 
#Generously [[Cookbook:Brush|brush]] filo pastry sheets with butter. 
#Spread apple mixture over pastry sheet. 
#Alternate with two layers of filo pastry for every layer of apple mixture. 
#Brush with melted butter. 
#[[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] for 30 minutes or until pastry is golden brown.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
*For more tartness, substitute for 3 red apples and 1 green apple.
